Source follow-up: Fresh original-only blind validation. Supplied primary published scan title and author list match the assigned original reference. Numerical result and table sample headers checked visually against PDF pages 4–5, rather than trusting embedded OCR. Locator p. 5 corresponds to published p. 782. The general-performance interaction is the uniquely significant Experiment 1 media-priming result at that locator; competence and integrity are separate tests and were not substituted. Original manuscript uses b2 for the interaction. Printed table headers really read n = 21 and n = 73; method total is 73, and the target interaction analytic n is not explicitly established.
